package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"

	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/commands"
	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/queries"
	"github.com/cratis/arc.go/validation"
)

// Loading and generation must never execute application initialization.
func init() {
	if os.Getenv("ARC_BINDINGS_GENERATION") == "trap" {
		panic("application initialization executed during generation")
	}
}

var Calls, ValueCalls, ValueCloses int
var ConstructorError = errors.New("constructor failed")
var LastFailure *Failure

//cratis:scoped
type Foo struct{ Closes int }

func NewFoo() *Foo          { Calls++; return &Foo{} }
func (f *Foo) Close() error { f.Closes++; return nil }
func (*Foo) Name() string   { return "foo" }

type IFoo interface {
	Name() string
	Close() error
}
type FooAlias = Foo

//cratis:singleton
type Singleton struct{ Closes int }

func NewSingleton(context.Context) (*Singleton, error) { Calls++; return &Singleton{}, nil }
func (s *Singleton) Close() error                      { s.Closes++; return nil }
func (*Singleton) Count() int                          { return 1 }

type ISingleton interface {
	Count() int
	Close() error
}

type Tick struct{ ID, Closes int }

func NewTick() *Tick          { Calls++; return &Tick{ID: Calls} }
func (t *Tick) Close() error  { t.Closes++; return nil }
func (t *Tick) Sequence() int { return t.ID }

type ITick interface {
	Sequence() int
	Close() error
}

type Dependency struct{ Err error }
type External struct{ Closes int }

func (e *External) Close() error { e.Closes++; return nil }

type Value struct{}

func NewValue(ctx context.Context, d *Dependency) (Value, error) {
	ValueCalls++
	if ctx == nil {
		panic("lost context")
	}
	return Value{}, d.Err
}
func (Value) Close() error { ValueCloses++; return nil }

type Failure struct{ Closes int }

func NewFailure(ctx context.Context, _ *Dependency) (*Failure, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		panic("lost context")
	}
	LastFailure = &Failure{}
	return LastFailure, ConstructorError
}
func (f *Failure) Close() error { f.Closes++; return nil }

type Pair struct{ First, Second *Tick }

func NewPair(a, b *Tick) Pair { return Pair{a, b} }

type Triple struct{ Ticks [3]*Tick }

func NewTriple(a, b, c *Tick) (Triple, error) { return Triple{[3]*Tick{a, b, c}}, nil }

type Quad struct{ Ticks [4]*Tick }

func NewQuad(ctx context.Context, a, b, c, d *Tick) Quad {
	if ctx == nil {
		panic("lost context")
	}
	return Quad{[4]*Tick{a, b, c, d}}
}

type Wide struct{ Ticks [5]*Tick }

func NewWide(ctx context.Context, a, b, c, d, e *Tick) (*Wide, error) {
	if ctx == nil {
		panic("lost context")
	}
	return &Wide{[5]*Tick{a, b, c, d, e}}, nil
}

//cratis:ignore-convention
type Ignored struct{}

func NewIgnored() *Ignored { panic("ignored service activated") }

//arc:command
//arc:allow-anonymous
type Add struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (c Add) Provide(context.Context) (string, error) { return c.Name, nil }
func (c Add) Validate(context.Context) ([]validation.Result, error) {
	if c.Name == "" {
		return []validation.Result{{Severity: validation.Error, Message: "name required"}}, nil
	}
	return nil, nil
}
func (Add) Handle(_ context.Context, name string, foo IFoo) (int, error) {
	return len(name) + len(foo.Name()), nil
}

//arc:command
//arc:authorize roles=Writer
type Denied struct{}

func (Denied) Handle(IFoo) error { panic("unauthorized Handle executed") }

//arc:command
//arc:allow-anonymous
type Stop struct{}

func (Stop) Provide(info commands.CommandContext) (commands.Result[commands.NoResponse], error) {
	return commands.Unauthorized(info.CorrelationID(), "stop"), nil
}
func (Stop) Handle(IFoo) error { panic("stopped Handle executed") }

//arc:readmodel name=Item
//arc:authorize roles=Reader
type Item struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}

func (Item) All(_ queries.NoArguments, foo IFoo) ([]Item, error) {
	return []Item{{Name: foo.Name()}}, nil
}

type QueryArgs struct {
	Count int `json:"count"`
}

//arc:query model=Item name=Find
//arc:allow-anonymous
func Find(args QueryArgs, foo IFoo) ([]Item, error) { return []Item{{Name: foo.Name()}}, nil }
